_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Devarim 27, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then Moses and the elders of the house of Israel commanded the people, saying: 'Observe all the commandments which I command you today.'
translations.2: And it shall be on the day that you cross the Jordan into the land which God your Lord is giving you — set up for yourself great stones, and whitewash them with white lead.
translations.3: And write upon them all the essentials of this Torah after your crossing, so that you may enter the land which God your Lord is giving you — a land flowing with milk and honey — as God the God of your fathers promised you.
translations.4: And so, from the first of your crossing the Jordan, you shall erect these stones which I have commanded you today on Mount Ebal, and whitewash them with white lead.
translations.5: And build there an altar to God your Lord — an altar of stones; do not move iron upon it.
translations.6: And let there be alongside that whole stones; and offer upon it ascent-offerings to God your Lord.
translations.7: And slaughter peace-offerings, and eat them there; and rejoice before God your Lord.
translations.8: And you shall write upon the stones all the essentials of the words of this Torah as a clear and good exposition.
translations.9: Then Moses and the imāms and the Levites spoke to the house of Israel, saying: 'Be attentive and hear, O house of Israel — for you, this very day, have become a people of God your Lord.'
translations.10: 'Accept His word, and do His commandments and His statutes which I command you today.'
translations.11: Then Moses commanded his people on that day, saying:
translations.12: 'These shall stand to bless the nation at Mount Gerizim, after your crossing the Jordan: the house of Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin.'
translations.13: 'And these shall stand over the curse upon Mount Ebal: the house of Reuben, and Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.'
translations.14: Then the Levites shall begin and say to all the house of Israel with a loud voice:
translations.15: 'Cursed is the man who makes a graven image or a cast image — of what God abhors — or takes one from the craft of an artisan and sets it in secret.' And all the people shall answer them and say: 'Amen.'
translations.16: 'Cursed is he who treats his father and his mother with contempt.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.17: 'Cursed is he who shifts the boundary of his neighbor.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.18: 'Cursed is he who leads one who is unknowing astray on the road.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.19: 'Cursed is he who perverts the judgment of a stranger, or an orphan, or a widow.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.20: 'Cursed is he who lies with the wife of his father — for he has uncovered the skirt of his father.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.21: 'Cursed is he who lies with anything of the beasts.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.22: 'Cursed is he who lies with his sister — the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.23: 'Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.24: 'Cursed is he who acts treacherously against his neighbor in secret.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.25: 'Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent soul.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
translations.26: 'Cursed is he who does not uphold the words of this Torah so as to act by them.' And all the people shall say: 'Amen.'
